<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="ניסן_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518918033_theRebbe_696" batchId="meluket-_D7_A0_D7_99_D7_A1_D7_9F_meluket__BH_POST_1766518918033_theRebbe_696__p004">
  <section v="9">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>Through the service of the exile in general, and especially at its conclusion, the innermost aspect of the soul draws down the innermost aspect from above, leading to a renewal in Torah and creation.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And through the service during the time of exile in general,</t>
    <t s="1">and in particular through the service at the conclusion of the exile,</t>
    <t s="2">that the service then is from the aspect of the innermost dimension of the soul,</t>
    <t s="3">through this they draw down the innermost dimension from above,</t>
    <t s="4">and up to the innermost dimension of Atik,</t>
    <t s="5">and through this there will be a renewal also in the Torah</t>
    <t s="6">(“A new Torah from Me shall go forth”),</t>
    <t s="7">that there will be drawn into it from the Giver of the Torah in a new manner.</t>
    <t s="8">[And it may be said,</t>
    <t s="9">that even this matter is accomplished through the service at the conclusion of the exile,</t>
    <t s="10">for when the service is in the manner of self-sacrifice (mesirut nefesh), then the study of Torah is for its own sake (lishmah).</t>
    <t s="11">And through this there is also a renewal in creation</t>
    <t s="12">(“He looked into the Torah and created the world”)</t>
    <t s="13">so that there will be new heavens and a new earth.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="10">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>May it be His will that through our deeds and service now we will very soon go to greet Moshiach, when the wonders of the Exodus will be fulfilled in actuality.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And may it be His will,</t>
    <t s="1">that all this will be very soon,</t>
    <t s="2">that through our deeds and our service</t>
    <t s="3">now we will go very soon to greet Moshiach our righteous one,</t>
    <t s="4">for then it will be fulfilled in actual reality: “As in the days of your going out from the land of Egypt, I will show him wonders,”</t>
    <t s="5">and we will be redeemed immediately.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
